name: Ayumi-chan LABO
source:
Main character receives a request to find out a demon among girl students of a private school. That is best done by defeating a girl possessed with demon in a card game. Girls include all stars from previous games.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角接到委托，要找出私立学校女学生中的恶魔。最好的方法是在纸牌游戏中击败一个被恶魔附身的女孩。女孩们包括之前比赛中的所有明星。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
